column1: # PictureSharp.Heif 0.5.0 (in development) on ARM64: Orange Pi 5, Rockchip RK3588 (4x Cortex-A76 2.35 GHz + 4x Cortex-A55
# 1.8 GHz, 8 GB), Ubuntu 24.04, .NET 10.0, 2026-10-17. Same files and method as speed-x64.tsv. Vector128 runs on NEON;
# Vector256 is not accelerated, so the 256-bit paths fall back to the 128-bit ones. "scalar" is DOTNET_EnableHWIntrinsic=0
# (no vector paths in the whole process, BCL included). libheif 1.17.6 with libde265 1.0.15 from the Ubuntu packages
# (the board has no heif-enc with x265). Decoded pixels and encoded bytes are identical to x64.
